thread.title: Investigation for Investors in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) over possible Securities Laws Violations announced

author: Shareholders Foundation
title: Investigation for Investors in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) over possible Securities Laws Violations announced
text: Press release from: Shareholders Foundation An investigation for investors in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) shares over potential securities laws violations by Apple Inc. An investigation was announced for investors in NASDAQ:AAPL shares over potential securities laws violations by Apple Inc. in connection with a software update that slowed the performance of older model iPhones.Investors who purchased shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL), have certain options and should contact the Shareholders Foundation at or call +1(858) 779 - 1554.The investigation by a law firm focuses on possible claims on behalf of purchasers of the securities of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) concerning whether a series of statements by Apple Inc. regarding its business, its prospects and its operations were materially false and misleading at the time they were made. In early 2017, Apple Inc. allegedly released a software update that slowed the performance of older model iPhones, without disclosing the impact of the update to consumers.When the foregoing conduct came to light, Apple Inc. was sued by consumer advocacy groups and individual iPhone users. On January 30, 2018, media outlets reported that the U.S. Department of Justice and Securities Exchange Commission are investigating whether Apple's disclosures with respect to the software update at issue violated securities laws. Shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) declined from $180.10 per share on January 18, 2018 to $156.00 per share on February 5, 2018. Those who purchased shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) have certain options and should contact the Shareholders Foundation.About Shareholders Foundation, Inc. The Shareholders Foundation, Inc. is a professional portfolio monitoring and settlement claim filing service, and an investor advocacy group, which does research related to shareholder issues and informs investors of securities class actions, settlements, judgments, and other legal related news to the stock/financial market. Shareholders Foundation, Inc. is in contact with a large number of shareholders and offers help, support, and assistance for every shareholder. The Shareholders Foundation, Inc. is not a law firm. The information is provided as a public service. It is not intended as legal advice and should not be relied upon.Media Contact:
